mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_transactions (stock_id, transaction_type, quantity_change, product_code, product_number, note, transaction_date, created_at) VALUES (#{stockId}, #{transactionType}, #{quantityChange}, #{productCode}, #{productNumber}, #{note}, #{transactionDate}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT t.transaction_date, t.transaction_type, m.name AS material_name, s.lot_number, t.quantity_change, t.product_code, i.name AS product_name, t.product_number, t.note FROM inventory_transactions t JOIN inventory_stocks s ON t.stock_id = s.id JOIN materials m ON s.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN items i ON t.product_code = CAST(i.id AS CHAR) ORDER BY t.transaction_date DESC, t.id DESC
